chapter: National Guard band and first jobs in Chicago
title: Who was in the Columbia Tavern band: McKendrick and Dolly Jones's family
summary: Personnel included guitarist Mike McKendrick, Dolly's mother on trumpet and her uncle Turk on drums; nobody recalls Dolly's surname.

blocks.x: Well, who else was in this band with you?

Bernie Young? Well, there's -- before he started out on guitar -- in fact he started out on the ukelele, and he used to tune his guitar up as a ukelele. We made him stop that and let him tune it up the way it should be. It was Mike McKendrick.
See? And we started, Mike out. And there was -- Dolly's mother played trumpet.
Oh, let's see. What was Dolly's mother's name? Oh, I don't know. Her uncle played drums.
Oh, my goodness. We had that didn't we?

Sure did, and (unintelligible) Dolly, all we know, you know the (unintelligible) the surname, All we did know was -- forget about it. We'd know the nickname. We always called her Dolly. (unintelligible) remember what that is? he
